title: 只在群里收到婚讯
prompt: Use case: precise story illustration edit. Recompose the image as a FIRST PERSON POV close-up. Show ONLY the holder's two hands with washed blue denim jacket cuffs and a single black smartphone front, no face or head or torso portrait. The owner and viewer share the same viewpoint looking down at the front display. Palm behind phone, fingers curl at edges, no fingers laid across text, no rear camera array on the display side. Reference 2 gives the correct hands-and-phone perspective only; its cafe, cup, time and reminder content must not be copied. The screen and hands occupy the upper central two-thirds. Use the original rental-room tabletop softly blurred. The phone shows a generic group chat: exactly “我们结婚了” and below it a closed unopened photo-attachment card with a generic landscape icon, not an actual wedding photograph. Two tiny response bubbles may read “谢谢” and “收到”. No visible person other than the hands, no wedding outfits or couple portraits, no dates or additional blessings. 保持完整横向16:9画幅、细腻半写实画风，不增加文字、边框、标题或水印。
